data.desc: Turn Therapeutics Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing targeted, non-systemic therapies designed to act directly at the site of disease. The Company's lead investigational candidate, GX-03, is being evaluated in atopic dermatitis and is also being developed for onychomycosis, with a planned expansion into hidradenitis suppurativa. Turn's research focuses on the intersection of microbial activity, local immune signaling and chronic inflammation.
